extension.summary: Standalone Stremio-style catalog/stream client for Kodi with TMDb Helper player integration, Plex/Emby companion sync, Trakt PIN linking and scrobble.
عميل مستقل لكتالوجات وروابط Stremio داخل Kodi مع دعم مشغّل TMDb Helper ومزامنة Plex/Emby وربط Trakt عبر PIN.
extension.description: Standalone Dex Hub for Kodi. Add any compatible Stremio manifest URL, browse provider catalogs, play streams with external subtitles, search Stremio subtitle addons and pass them to Kodi, sync playback progress through built-in companion support for Plex and Emby, link Trakt via built-in PIN auth, scrobble, import progress with Trakt, reuse Dex Hub as a TMDb Helper player, and keep a unified local continue-watching list.

Dex Hub نسخة مستقلة لـ Kodi. أضف أي رابط Stremio manifest متوافق، تصفح كتالوجات المزودين، شغّل الروابط مع ترجمات خارجية، ابحث في إضافات ترجمة Stremio ومرّرها إلى Kodi، زامِن التقدم عبر Plex وEmby، اربط Trakt عبر PIN وسجّل المشاهدة، استخدم Dex Hub كمشغّل لـ TMDb Helper، وحافظ على قائمة متابعة موحّدة محلياً.

extension.news:
v4.0.7 - The results window can now be SORTED, not just filtered: by size, quality, source or name, with the recommended ranking as default. Sort and filter apply together and the choice is remembered.
v4.0.6 - Fixed a bridge addon's streams appearing several times over. Each Stremio provider is queried with up to four id variants and bridges answer identically to all of them; repeated rows from the same provider are now collapsed. Rows from different addons are untouched. - The source dedupe setting is now visible and actually applied.
v4.0.5 - Fixed duplicate rows in folders. Arabic titles are now normalised (hamza, ta marbuta, tatweel, harakat, Arabic-Indic digits) before comparison, items are merged across imdb/tmdb/tvdb ids instead of only the first id found, and a source that omits the year no longer produces a second row.
v4.0.4 - Values substituted into a label (Enabled/Stopped, Connected, Poster/Background and 39 others) are now translated too.
v4.0.3 - Fixed counted labels (Continue, Favourites, Sources) and 99 other labels that stayed Arabic because the number was substituted before the string was translated.
v4.0.2 - The English UI is now complete: 273 more labels, dialogs, plot lines and notifications translated. - Dialogs that bypassed the translator (Emby login, Plex unlink, sort pickers, file browsers, sync notifications) now go through it. - Catalog keyword matching is untouched by design; see TODO-logic-strings.txt.
v4.0.1 - English UI: 123 dialog and menu labels that fell back to Arabic are now translated. - Faster: settings reads are cached per invocation and the translation lookup is memoised, removing a full 740-key scan on every untranslated label. - Security: restored TLS certificate verification on the artwork-preset fetch. - Community build: removed the in-addon subscription pitch.
v4.0.0 - Nuvio and Stremio sync are now fully independent: each service has its own direction, its own addon and Continue Watching toggles, and its own "Sync now". - Fixed "Sync now" in the menus, which called an action that was never registered. - Sync settings are now a visible section under Accounts instead of being hidden entirely. - Periodic sync honours the chosen direction instead of always running both ways.

extension.summary: Propose to play the next episode automatically
extension.description:
A service add-on that shows a Netflix-style notification for watching the next episode. After a few automatic iterations it asks the user if he is still there watching.
A lot of existing add-ons already integrate with this service out-of-the-box.
extension.summary: Bietet Ihnen an, die nächste Episode automatisch wiederzugeben
extension.description:
Ein kleines Hilfs-Add-on, welches eine Netflix-artige Benachrichtigung zur Wiedergabe der nächsten Episode anzeigt. Nach ein paar automatischen Iterationen fragt es den Anwender, ob er sie immer noch anschaut.
Viele existierende Add-ons haben diesen Dienst bereits von Haus aus integriert.
extension.summary: Propone di riprodurre automaticamente il prossimo episodio
extension.description:
Un add-on di servizio che mostra una notifica in stile Netflix per guardare il prossimo episodio. Dopo alcune iterazioni automatiche, chiede all'utente se è ancora lì a guardare.
Molti add-on esistenti hanno già integrato questo servizio.
extension.summary: Προτάση για αναπαραγωγή του επόμενου επεισοδίου αυτόματα
extension.description:
Ένα υπηρεσιακό πρόσθετο που δείχνει σε στύλ ειδοποίησης τύπου Νέτφλιξ για την αναπαραγωγή του επόμενου επεισοδίου. Μετά από μερικές αυτόματες εκτελέσεις, ρωτάει τον χρήστη εάν παρακολουθεί ακόμα.
Πολλά από τα υπάρχοντα πρόσθετα ενσωματώνουν την λειτουργία αυτού του υπηρεσιακού προσθέτου εξ'ορισμού.
extension.summary: Låter dig spela upp nästa avsnitt automatiskt
extension.description:
Ett tillägg som visar en Netflix-liknande avisering för att se nästa avsnitt. Efter att några avsnitt automatiskt spelats upp frågar den användaren om han fortfarande är där och vill titta vidare.
Många befintliga tillägg integreras redan med den här utanför lådan-tjänsten.

Сервисное дополнение, которое показывает уведомление в стиле Netflix для просмотра следующей серии. После нескольких автоматических итераций спрашивает пользователя, он еще смотрит или нет.
Многие существующие дополнения уже интегрированы с этим сервисом "из коробки".
extension.summary: Sugiere reproducir el próximo episodio automáticamente
extension.description:
Un complemento de servicio que muestra una notificación al estilo Netflix para ver el próximo episodio. Después de algunas iteraciones automáticas, le pregunta al usuario si todavía está allí mirando.
Muchos complementos existentes ya se integran con este servicio listo para usar.
